annotations.title: Best months for an activity or species

description: Ranks the calendar months for one thing at one place: an activity (dive, snorkel, freedive, whale_swim), a species (e.g. manta, whale shark), or calm seas / warm water / clear water. Says whether the ranking comes from multi-year data or curated research seasons, with confidence and caveats. A decision call: metered, free during early access.

for.description: What to plan for: an activity (dive, snorkel, freedive, whale_swim), a species word (e.g. "manta", "whale shark"), or calm / warm / clear.

lat.description: Latitude; resolves to the nearest covered area within 50 km. Use with lon.

spot.description: Spot id; resolves to the area containing it.
